pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown contiguous regions exhibit high edge angularity with sharp pixel gradients, forming irregular polygonal shapes. Patch spatial area is relatively consistent on the mid-flank, while patches on the neck appear more elongated and slightly more fragmented.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: High-reflectance cream pathways form a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, showing increased pixel width in the ventral-posterior region compared to the narrower channels on the upper neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The 1D geometric contour is defined by short, dark bristly protrusions against the lighter background of the upper neck and shoulder.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Visual continuity of the mane line is interrupted by localized structural breaks caused by the presence of small, dark avian organisms perched along the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple discrete, dark-colored pixel clusters identified as oxpeckers perched on the dorsal ridge and lateral shoulder area.
